caption: The drawing depicts the interior corner of a wooden room, with horizontal planks that vary in shades of brown dominating the background. In the left foreground, there is a large, rounded, high-backed chair or tub, colored in dark earthy tones with hints of reddish-brown and blue shadows, and a single dark circular spot visible on the backrest. To the right of the chair or tub, there is a simple wooden bench with a pale, flat top and angled legs, positioned against the wall. The floor consists of diagonal wooden planks in lighter beige and brown hues. The scene is composed with the chair or tub and bench placed closely together, and there's visible shading that indicates the direction of light in the room.
title: Muskego Church Chair
